summary: San Jacinto County tower listed as gone, though a Handbook of Texas entry last revised in 1995 says it remained at the settlement.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association. A Handbook of Texas entry, last revised in 1995, says the lookout tower remains.

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on the fate. The Forest Fire Lookout Association Texas list marks the tower Gone. The Handbook of Texas entry (last revised June 1, 1995) says the lookout tower remains at the settlement. The story gives both and does not pick one. The Texas Almanac data linked from the same Handbook page lists the community as not currently existing; left out because it is about the place, not the tower, and I did not verify it. Agency Texas Forest Service comes from the centraluslookouts roster; the tnlandforms roster tags the tower TFS. No build date, height, staffing or fate found in two searches. Brief gone status is kept. Checked 2026-10-21: the Handbook sentence was reworded because it copied the quote's wording, and footnote [^3] was removed from the no-source sentence, because the FFLA page does not say that.
